s3.ptxt: Using a vernier caliper, measure the free length of the compression spring.

atten3.ptxt: If it is less than the minimum, replace the spring with a new one.

s2.ptxt: Gasket Installation

s3.ptxt: Insert a new gasket into exhaust center pipe sub-assembly CTR NO.2 as far as it will go by hand.

item.ptxt: Do not install the gasket in the wrong direction.
Do not reuse a gasket once it has been removed.
Do not damage the gasket by dropping it, etc.
Do not damage the gasket sliding surface.
Never push the gasket in by installing the exhaust pipe without first pressing it in sufficiently by hand.

atten3.ptxt: After installation, check that there is no significant difference in the clearance between the flanges of exhaust center pipe sub-assembly CTR NO.2 and the exhaust tail pipe assembly at the front, rear, left and right.
